description: Historical forecast definition: which archived forecast to return instead of history or live forecast. Used by solargis_public_TS_historical_forecast_request.schema.json.

HistoricalForecast.description: Which historical forecast to return. type CONCATENATED: fixed lead; for every day (P*D) or time step (PT*H) of fromDate..toDate, the forecast that was N days or hours ahead, joined into one series, as an operational delivery would have received it; one series per requested lead period. type SINGLE: fixed issue; one snapshot, the forecast as available at processingDateTime, at most 5 days ahead.

type.description: CONCATENATED: one series built from forecasts with the same lead. SINGLE: one forecast as available at one instant.

leadPeriods.description: CONCATENATED only. Lead periods to return, all P*D or all PT*H. Every requested column that depends on the forecast irradiance (irradiance, its derived and PV columns, LEADTIME) is returned once per lead period, named <column>_<leadPeriod>, e.g. GHI_P1D, PVOUT_PT1H, LEADTIME_P1D, and carries the lead period in its column metadata (leadPeriod). The suffix is added for a single lead period too. Other columns (meteo, ALB, sun position) are the same for every lead period and are returned once, without suffix and without leadPeriod.

processingTime.description: CONCATENATED with P*D lead periods only. Time of day the forecast is processed, shared by all lead periods, with an explicit offset (HH:MM+hh:mm, HH:MM-hh:mm or HH:MMZ), e.g. 10:30+01:00. Every day of the range gets the forecast as it would have been delivered at that instant: only forecast runs available by then are used (NWP runs a few hours after their issue time, satellite nowcast minutes after its time slot). Fixed offset, no daylight saving time.

processingDateTime.description: SINGLE only. When the forecast is processed, ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 with an explicit offset, e.g. 2026-03-03T10:30:00+01:00. Returns the forecast as it would have been delivered at that instant: only forecast runs available by then are used. fromDate must not be earlier than its date, and toDate at most 4 days after it.

sources.description: Forecast archives to read. NWP_FORECAST: numerical weather prediction models. NOWCAST: satellite-based nowcast. With both, they are blended as in operational forecasting. Defaults: [NWP_FORECAST] for CONCATENATED P*D, [NWP_FORECAST, NOWCAST] for CONCATENATED PT*H and SINGLE. Shared by all lead periods. NOWCAST alone covers only the first hours after the forecast is processed.

allOf.$comment: SINGLE: processingDateTime required, leadPeriods and processingTime forbidden.
PT*H: processingTime forbidden, the lead hours alone define the forecast.
P1D-P4D: no NOWCAST, its horizon of a few hours cannot reach the next day.
P0D and SINGLE: NOWCAST alone is rejected, a whole-day window always exceeds the nowcast horizon. Add NWP_FORECAST.

LeadPeriod.description: Lead period of a historical forecast, ISO 8601 duration as timeStep. P0D-P4D: the forecast processed N days before each target day, at processingTime. PT0H-PT4H: the forecast issued N hours before each time step; blends satellite nowcast with NWP forecast.
